0412Finance, banking and insurance

ClaimWatch

Space · praveen81/claimwatch

Route each insurance claim in a queue (approve, review, request info, deny, flag fraud) under reviewer capacity and SLA limits.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • capacity-constrained routing
  • GRPO or PPO with rubric rewards

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Per-step rewards (e.g. +0.45 correct fraud flag, -0.60 false denial) clamped to [-1,1]; task graders combine routing accuracy, SLA and fraud rates.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/reset \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"task_id": 1, "seed": 42}'

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/praveen81/claimwatch
cd claimwatch

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.
